subject: english
question:
Read the given sentence carefully and fill in the blank by selecting the correct synonym of the word given in the brackets.

The authority refused to pay any heed to the _________ demands made by the workers. (Trivial)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3** i.e. **insignificant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**trivial**" means of little value or importance.
 
• The synonym for "**trivial**" that fits the context of the sentence is "**insignificant**".
 
• ​**Insignificant **means too small or unimportant to be worth consideration.
 
• "Conceited", "idiotic", and "majestic" do not convey the same meaning as "**trivial**" and thus are incorrect.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **insignificant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conceited (अभिमानी)** means having an excessively high opinion of oneself.
 
• **Idiotic (मूर्खतापूर्ण)** means very stupid.
 
• **Majestic (शानदार)** means having or showing impressive beauty or dignity.
